# D01 拉格朗日中值定理

完整知识单元课堂参考草稿，按数学内容选择组织方式。本示例仅供理解教学行为，实际项目应重新设计板书、布局、动画和节奏；关联题规则以当前项目为准。以下代码尚未经过真实成片验收。

```python title=scene_01
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class D01Part1(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("拉格朗日中值定理", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("D01_1_1", "曲线上存在切线与端点割线平行，关键是连续与可导这两个条件。", "", tts_text="曲线上存在切线与端点割线平行，关键是连续与可导这两个条件。")
        line_1 = Text("闭区间连续，开区间可导", color=BLACK, font_size=28)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D01_1_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("D01_1_1")
        self.start_cue("D01_1_2", "设 a 小于 b，函数在闭区间连续且在开区间可导，则至少存在一点 xi，使导数等于割线斜率。", "", tts_text="设 a 小于 b，函数在闭区间连续且在开区间可导，则至少存在一点 xi，使导数等于割线斜率。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"f'(\xi)=\frac{f(b)-f(a)}{b-a},\quad a<\xi<b", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D01_1_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("D01_1_2")
```

```python title=scene_02
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class D01Part2(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("拉格朗日中值定理", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("D01_2_1", "希望将端点函数值变成相等，从而使用罗尔定理。取端点割线的斜率作为辅助函数的线性项。", "", tts_text="希望将端点函数值变成相等，从而使用罗尔定理。取端点割线的斜率作为辅助函数的线性项。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"k=\frac{f(b)-f(a)}{b-a}", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D01_2_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("D01_2_1")
        self.start_cue("D01_2_2", "令 F 等于 f 减去斜率为 k 的直线项，原函数的连续可导性保留。", "", tts_text="令 F 等于 f 减去斜率为 k 的直线项，原函数的连续可导性保留。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"F(x)=f(x)-k(x-a)", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D01_2_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("D01_2_2")
        self.start_cue("D01_2_3", "F 在 a 和 b 两点的函数值都等于 f 在 a 处的值。", "", tts_text="F 在 a 和 b 两点的函数值都等于 f 在 a 处的值。")
        line_3 = MathTex(r"F(a)=F(b)=f(a)", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_3.next_to(line_2, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_3), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D01_2_3", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2, line3=line_3)
        self.end_cue("D01_2_3")
        self.start_cue("D01_2_4", "由罗尔定理，存在 xi 使 F 的导数为零，因此原函数的导数等于 k。", "", tts_text="由罗尔定理，存在 xi 使 F 的导数为零，因此原函数的导数等于 k。")
        self.play(FadeOut(line_1), FadeOut(line_2), FadeOut(line_3), run_time=min(0.35, self.cue_time_left()*0.15))
        line_4 = MathTex(r"0=F'(\xi)=f'(\xi)-k", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_4, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_4), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D01_2_4", heading=heading, line1=line_4)
        self.end_cue("D01_2_4")
```

```python title=scene_03
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class D01Part3(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("拉格朗日中值定理", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("D01_3_1", "例题：函数 x 平方在一到三上满足条件，求中值点。", "", tts_text="例题：函数 x 平方在一到三上满足条件，求中值点。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"f(x)=x^2,\quad [1,3]", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D01_3_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("D01_3_1")
        self.start_cue("D01_3_2", "割线斜率等于九减一除以二，即四。", "", tts_text="割线斜率等于九减一除以二，即四。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"\frac{9-1}{3-1}=4", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D01_3_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("D01_3_2")
        self.start_cue("D01_3_3", "令二 xi 等于四，得到 xi 等于二，属于开区间。", "", tts_text="令二 xi 等于四，得到 xi 等于二，属于开区间。")
        line_3 = MathTex(r"2\xi=4\Rightarrow \xi=2\in(1,3)", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_3.next_to(line_2, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_3), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D01_3_3", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2, line3=line_3)
        self.end_cue("D01_3_3")
```

```python title=scene_04
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class D01Part4(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("拉格朗日中值定理", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("D01_4_1", "总结：先检查条件，再计算割线斜率并令导数等于它。证明的核心是减去割线的线性项，转化为罗尔定理。", "", tts_text="总结：先检查条件，再计算割线斜率并令导数等于它。证明的核心是减去割线的线性项，转化为罗尔定理。")
        line_1 = Text("条件 → 割线斜率 → 导数方程", color=BLACK, font_size=28)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D01_4_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("D01_4_1")
        self.start_cue("D01_4_2", "定理只保证至少存在一点，不保证唯一。", "", tts_text="定理只保证至少存在一点，不保证唯一。")
        line_2 = Text("存在性，不保证唯一", color=BLACK, font_size=28)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        line_2.set_color("#1D4ED8")
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D01_4_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("D01_4_2")
```
